Name: Simple Storage Terminal 2 (New Update)
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]📦 Simple Storage Terminal 2[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]PC · Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ · SMAPI 4.4.0+[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Search and manage a connected chest network from one terminal, then add Workshop crafting and remote access as your farm progresses.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]📦 Build a Chest Network[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]The starter terminal connects to up to [b]eight ordinary wooden or stone chests[/b]. Buy its recipe from Robin at [b]Farming level 6[/b] for [b]10,000g[/b], then craft with [b]50 Wood, 5 Iron Bars, 1 Refined Quartz and 1 Battery Pack[/b].

Chests must touch the terminal or another connected chest [b]up, down, left or right[/b]. Diagonals, gaps, connector floors and machines do not extend the network. Items remain in their physical chests.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🔧 Bigger Terminal and Workshop[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Connect exactly eight ordinary chests to a starter terminal to trigger Robin’s next-morning letter. The Bigger Terminal Upgrade recipe then costs [b]10,000g[/b]: craft with [b]1,000 Wood, 5 Gold Bars, 2 Iridium Bars and 2 Battery Packs[/b]. Robin also sells the finished upgrade for [b]50,000g[/b]. Use the module on the placed starter terminal.

Bigger Terminals also support Big Chests and Big Stone Chests. [b]Simple Chest Upgrade 1.0.1+[/b] optionally adds its Expanded Chests. The eight-chest limit remains.

Hold a vanilla [b]Workbench[/b] and interact with a terminal to install its Workshop. This consumes one Workbench and enables crafting from your backpack and that terminal’s connected chests. Each terminal upgrades separately.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]🔎 Search and Transfer[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Search item names, descriptions or available colour tags. Choose category filtering or highlighted matches, then transfer a [b]Stack[/b], [b]One[/b] or a [b]Custom Amount[/b]. Quick Deposit moves matching item types already in storage.

Sort by Stardew order, name or amount. Tooltips include sell prices and the save’s Community Center bundle requirements. Backpack capacity follows your purchased slots, including 72 and 84.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]🌐 Permanent Remote Access[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]After the eight-chest progression and Robin letter, the host can buy farm-wide remote access at Robin for [b]5,000,000g[/b]. Pair it to one Bigger Terminal.

Open your inventory and use the remote shortcut to access storage. To pair or change the connection, stand beside the desired Bigger Terminal and right-click the shortcut. Controller: left stick opens; left shoulder + left stick pairs. Remote crafting requires the paired terminal’s Workshop.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]⚙ Settings and Compatibility[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Optional [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] offers menu size and remembered search/filter settings. Choose Standard if a larger layout overlaps another interface. Includes all twelve game languages.

Optional Simple Pouch crafting requires ingredient use enabled in both mods. Favourites are excluded from crafting. Fridges, Junimo storage, shipping bins and unrelated custom chest types are excluded from terminal networks.

Use the same terminal version for host and farmhands. Mods that replace storage or ignore native chest locks may conflict. Automate and Content Patcher are not required.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]📦 Install, Update or Remove[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.4.0+[/b]. Install [b]SimpleTerminal[/b] in Mods and launch through SMAPI. Replace the old SimpleTerminalStorage or SimpleTerminalStorageClassic installation, preserve config.json, and keep only one terminal version.

Before uninstalling in single-player, close menus and run [b]cs_terminal restore confirm[/b] to remove discoverable terminal items and progression, then save and quit. This does not refund costs. Chest contents stay in their native chests; use the separate Chest Upgrade removal instructions for expanded chests.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#67E8F9]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a report or suggestion on this mod's page.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]For bug reports, please include:[/color][/b]
[color=#E5E7EB]• Mod version, game/SMAPI version and platform.
• What happened, what you expected and steps to reproduce it.
• A [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url], if applicable.
• A screenshot or short video, if helpful.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]For suggestions:[/color][/b]
[color=#E5E7EB]Tell me what you would like added or changed and how it would improve the mod.[/color][/size][/center]
